How It Works

Live in four steps

01

Request Access

Fill the Request Access form below — artist or label. Our team reviews it and sets up your dashboard.

02

Upload Your Music

Add audio, artwork, lyrics and credits. We generate ISRC & UPC free.

We Deliver Globally

Quality check, then delivery to 150+ platforms in 2–5 days.

04

Get Paid in INR

Track earnings daily. Withdraw via UPI or bank once you cross ₹500.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Use the Request Access form on this page — artists and labels both apply there. Tell us your name, contact details, music links and the services you need. Our team reviews every request and replies on email / WhatsApp with your dashboard access and next steps.
Yes. Distribution is completely free — ₹0 to join and release unlimited music. You keep up to 85% of the royalties we collect for you. No hidden upload fees, no per-platform charges, no subscription.
Always. Free Music Distro is non-exclusive — you keep 100% ownership of your masters and can leave anytime. We license your music only to deliver and monetise it on the platforms you choose.
Most releases go live in 2–5 business days after our quality check, subject to each platform's own review time. We recommend uploading 3 weeks before your release date for playlist pitching.
Royalties land in your dashboard monthly. Once your balance crosses ₹500, withdraw to UPI, Paytm or your Indian bank account — payouts typically arrive in 1–2 business days. International artists can choose PayPal or wire.
150+ platforms including Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, JioSaavn, Gaana, Amazon Music, Instagram, TikTok, Deezer, Tidal, Wynk, Hungama, Boomplay and Audiomack — plus caller-tune (CRBT) delivery in India.
Yes — and you keep your stream counts and playlist placements when you transfer with the same ISRCs. Our team helps with back-catalogue migration at no extra charge.
Yes, with the right licences. Covers need a mechanical licence where required, and remixes need permission from the original rights holder. Upload your licence in the dashboard and our team will verify it before delivery.
